text_block_list.text:
It's not a big deal... My temples just hurt
a little...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...Tch. Maybe it was a bit chilly
yesterday after I
got out of the bath...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I should have dried my hair right away
before the
night air touched it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Imagine Brian's hair flowing in the night
breeze...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Ngh?! It's echoing... in my skull...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан's headache continues for a
while
after.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
